fields.name: entries
fields.tooltip: Courses in the order the strip shows them. Synced from the Tracks folder; reorder and edit freely.

fields.name: track
fields.tooltip: The saved track this course plays.

fields.name: displayName
fields.tooltip: The course's name on the SELECT COURSE screen. Empty = the asset's name.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.tooltip: A second line under the name (the F-Zero 'Twist Road' line). Empty = none.

fields.name: difficulty
fields.tooltip: Difficulty pips shown under the map.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.tooltip: Optional picture for the bottom strip. Empty = a small map of the track is drawn instead.
